pages.lesson:
LESSON: SELECTED HADITH INTENTION THE CHOICE OF FRIENDS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.1 Ulumul Hadith • forms of Hadith • components of Hadith • types of Had
Topic 2.2: Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What are the benefits of having good intention?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. practise the teachings from the selected hadith in daily life
2. appreciate Hadith as the second source of Islamic law and spiritual guidance.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. practise the teachings from the selected hadith in daily life
   In simple words: practise until you can practise the teachings from the selected hadith in daily life. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. appreciate Hadith as the second source of Islamic law and spiritual guidance.
   In simple words: practise until you can appreciate Hadith as the second source of Islamic law and spiritual guidance. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends in the examples.
2. Explain Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends.
4. Show that you can: practise the teachings from the selected hadith in daily life

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss lessons derived from the selected hadith and make a class presentation
2. Discuss the relevance of the selected Hadith in the life of a Muslim and make notes,
3. Role-play the qualities and importance of having good friends
4. Citizenship: active community life skills as learners become socially aware of the choice of friends to make.
5. Self-efficacy: knowing who I am as learners create social groups to share information.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are the benefits of having good intention?
2. Why is it important to choose good friends?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. practise the teachings from the selected hadith in daily life
2. appreciate Hadith as the second source of Islamic law and spiritual guidance.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
